From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency [E · measured_j]

Unpacking a 52.72x-compressed 0.1517 bpw matrix to FP32 cost 81.86x MORE energy than INT8 on Kria KV260 (TI INA260 shunt: 63,335.56 vs 773.74 uJ). Packed integers beat INT8 4.13x (187.49 uJ).

1/2 Physical DC shunts (measured_j) & 4-ISA lockstep (@ 813eb96):
- 4-stage cascade cut KV260 INA260 26.58x gross / 24.49x net (685.43 vs 18,221.99 uJ; 0.09-0.11% drift PASS) & Jetson Thor INA3221 16.26x
- waiOS 256x128: 0/400 disagrees; row-77 tamper -> HALT

2/2 Strict non-mixing (measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j) & scope:
- Linux RAPL (reported_j, orthogonal to shunts): 54.78x i9 & 46.49x Ryzen unpack tax; 20.78x Ryzen cascade cut
- Stage-4 calls: 26/1,000 (38.46x, est_j isolated)
- Thor Falsifier 6: net withheld
